operator_instruction: dismiss all conjectures in conjecture net that aim at proving Hodge right. add all conjectures that that aim to prove Hodge wrong
objective: Refute rational Hodge by a valid counterexample; test the operator's higher-coherence obstruction conjecture.
dismissal_semantics: Administrative dismissal from active research, not mathematical falsification or deletion of historical results.
registration_semantics: Open hypotheses and proof obligations, not established counterexamples. This inventory does not exhaust all possible mathematical conjectures.

fixed-candidate-nonalgebraicity.scope: The unchanged selected sixfold X, p=3 and alpha in the work-net scope; all rational algebraic cycle combinations.
fixed-candidate-nonalgebraicity.statement: The fixed rational (3,3) class alpha is outside the image of cl:CH^3(X)_Q -> Hdg^3(X,Q).
fixed-candidate-nonalgebraicity.acceptance: A proof excluding every codimension-three algebraic cycle combination on this exact X, independently reviewed; failure of a source library is insufficient.
fixed-candidate-nonalgebraicity.falsifier: An actual rational algebraic cycle combination on this X whose class is alpha refutes this hypothesis. Such a falsifier must be accepted even though confirmation-directed search is dismissed.
fixed-candidate-nonalgebraicity.next_action: Audit the first missing universal-over-cycles theorem for the existing candidate obstruction; do not restart Prym matching or prime screening.
fixed-candidate-nonalgebraicity.deliverable: An all-cycle separation proof, or a source-bound falsification of this fixed-candidate hypothesis.

higher-coherence-counterexample-existenc.scope: An independently selected smooth projective complex X, codimension p and rational Hodge alpha; a different candidate requires its own frozen source packet.
higher-coherence-counterexample-existenc.statement: There exist X,p,alpha and a noncircular class-level rational higher-coherence detector O such that O(cl(Z))=0 for every rational algebraic cycle Z but O(alpha) is nonzero.
higher-coherence-counterexample-existenc.acceptance: Construct the detector and its rational target independently, prove all-cycle necessity, cohomology descent and non-torsion detection on one common source, then obtain independent review.
higher-coherence-counterexample-existenc.falsifier: A detected known algebraic class, presentation dependence, torsion-only detection or circular quotient invalidates a proposed witness. Rejecting one witness does not disprove this existential conjecture; a proof of rational Hodge would disprove it.
higher-coherence-counterexample-existenc.next_action: Audit whether the cycle-supplied coherence dictionary yields an algebraic-specific necessity theorem rather than universal topological chain closure. Register any alternative detector before computing its value.
higher-coherence-counterexample-existenc.deliverable: An explicit source-bound separating detector and its necessity theorem, or a precisely rejected proposed witness.
